note: P4301 (Pro 27:14) — a loud early-morning blessing of a neighbour is counted as cursing.

dims.v: tactless flattery — praise so loud and ill-timed it grates like a curse
the blessing of a neighbour with a loud voice, rising early — effusiveness so excessive and ill-timed that it is taken not as kindness but as a curse
the over-loud praise that offends where it means to please

barak (bless) — 'whoever BLESSES his neighbor with a loud voice, rising early... will be counted as cursing'; praise overdone and ill-timed becomes an offence. Effusive flattery grates like the very curse it is not. Tact reads the moment.
